_comment_ConnectionStrings: Never set MvTeaches here. Use user-secrets locally (dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:MvTeaches" "...") or the MVTEACHES_ConnectionStrings__MvTeaches environment variable in staging/production. See /docs/deployment/README.md.
_comment_DataProtection: Where the Data Protection key ring is persisted — it encrypts teachers' Zoom/Google OAuth tokens at rest and MUST live outside the database on a persistent volume, or every stored token becomes undecryptable after a redeploy. Empty here = a folder next to the binaries (fine for local dev only). See /docs/deployment/README.md.
_comment_Zoom: A USER-AUTHORIZED Zoom OAuth app (Zoom General App with OAuth), NOT Server-to-Server — there is deliberately no centre AccountId. Each teacher authorizes their own Zoom account. Empty here = the Connect Zoom button reports 'not configured' and no meeting can be created.
_comment_GoogleMeet: A Google Cloud project with the Google Meet REST API enabled and an OAuth consent screen for external users. Each teacher authorizes their own (free is fine) Google account. Empty here = the Connect Google Meet button reports 'not configured'.
_comment_WhatsApp: Populate once Meta Business verification completes (README: awaiting Meta's reply). Empty here = NotConfiguredWhatsAppSender is used.
_comment_Smtp: D-57's OTP backup channel. Populate Host to enable real email sending.
_comment_Bootstrap: One-time-only: creates the very first Admin account if the Admin role has zero members. Set these via user-secrets/env var for the first run, then remove them (see /docs/deployment/README.md) - never commit real values here.
